rationale: IEC 60909 positive-sequence short-circuit calculation: summed grid, transformer, and bus duct impedances to obtain network impedance. Maximum current computed with c_max=1.1 and bolted fault (no fault resistance). Minimum current computed with c_min=1.0 and fault resistance 0.005 pu included. Base current = 100/(√3×10.5) = 5.4982 kA.
